items.t: Said the plan for energy independence by 2045 can be accomplished but obstacles need to be removed.
items.q: The plan for energy independence by 2045 "can be accomplished, but we need to remove obstacles," she added.

record.t: Co-hosted an informational meeting on the North Kohala Agricultural Water Study with the Department of Land and Natural Resources.
record.q: An upcoming informational meeting on the North Kohala Agricultural Water Study will be jointly hosted by the Department of Land and Natural Resources (DLNR) and Hawai’i Island Senator Lorraine Inouye.

record.t: Supported legislative funding for the North Kohala Agricultural Water Study.
record.q: Funds for this study were appropriated by the Legislature with the support of Senator Inouye.

record.t: Co-sponsored Senate Concurrent Resolution 34, which urges Congress to grant budget autonomy, legislative autonomy and statehood to the District of Columbia.
record.q: Hawaii Senate Concurrent Resolution (SCR) 34 was introduced by Senator Clarence Nishihara (D) and co-sponsored by Senators Will Espero (D), Gil Keith-Agaran (D), Suzanne Chun Oakland (D) and Lorraine Inouye (D).

record.t: Served on the Energy and Transportation Committee.
record.q: Hawaii state Sen. Lorraine Inouye, who is on the Energy and Transportation Committee, said she is encouraged that people are taking the initiative to become energy independent.

record.t: Introduced legislation that also establishes the Banyan Drive-Makaoku Community Development District Special Fund.
record.q: The legislation, introduced by Sen. Lorraine Inouye of Hilo, with fellow Big Island Democratic Sens. Dru Kanuha and Joy San Buenaventura as co- signers, also establishes the Banyan Drive-Makaoku Community Development District Special Fund.
